findings.text: These cues do not authorize you to make a decision.
findings.what: A cue does not 'authorize' a decision; the point (next sentence, and the section) is that the cue should not make or force a decision for you, so 'authorize' reads as the wrong verb.
findings.fix: These cues do not make a decision for you.

findings.fix: I will choose new small behaviors using an Implementation Intention.

findings.text: especially when they were led to (which NLP tends to)
findings.what: 'led to' has no object; it should be 'were led' (by leading questions), and '(which NLP tends to)' dangles without its verb.
findings.fix: especially when they were led (which NLP tends to do)
